# BirdCheck — Documentation

> Versioned public documentation for BirdCheck. Source snapshot: iOS 1.0 build 8 (October 29, 2026); draft pending final review. This is a product guide, not access to any user's private records.

## General guides
- [Overview](docs/README.md): What BirdCheck does and where to start.
- [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md): Home screen and first use.
- [Life List & Checklists](docs/lists-and-life-list.md): Species seen and reusable lists.
- [Outings & Sightings](docs/outings-and-sightings.md): Recording birds and historical entries.
- [Map & Locations](docs/map-and-locations.md): Saved geography and map counts.
- [Bird Cards & Photos](docs/bird-cards-and-photos.md): Six-photo gallery and user pictures.
- [BirdCheck AI](docs/birdcheck-ai.md): Voice/text questions and limitations.
- [Apple Watch & Fitness](docs/apple-watch-and-fitness.md): Watch operation.
- [Backups & iCloud](docs/backup-and-icloud.md): Personal records, snapshots, restore, sync.
- [Settings & Privacy](docs/settings-and-privacy.md): Controls and permissions.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): Concise answers.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): Common problems.

## Technical reference for accurate answers
- [Feature facts](docs/reference/feature-facts.md): Source-grounded capabilities and exclusions.
- [Data definitions](docs/reference/data-definitions.md): Observation, species, Life List, region and counts.
- [AI answering guide](docs/reference/ai-answering-guide.md): Support answer guidelines and privacy rules.
- [Source map](docs/reference/source-map.md): Swift implementation map.
- [Verification](docs/reference/verification.md): What has and hasn't been confirmed.

Important: An external AI reading these Markdown files does not have access to the private BirdCheck database and must not claim to know a person's saved birds, dates, or locations. BirdCheck 1.0 build 8 does not use live WeatherKit.
